# Pettifer

## Overview

- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v2 c1 P5](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0005)</sub>
- **Origin:** New Brunswick  <sub>[v2 c1 P5](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0005)</sub>
- **Role:** Farmer  <sub>[v2 c1 P5](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0005)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** J. A.  <sub>[v2 c1 P1](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0001)</sub>

## Appearance

Mr. Pettifer is short, heavy-set, and bald, except for a small strip of hair around his ears. He has a round face, bulging blue eyes, and lacks hair on his scalp.

_Sources: [v2 c1 P11](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0011), [v2 c1 P21](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0021)_

## Personality

He is an eccentric, stingy, and quick-tempered man known around Brierley as a "crank." He is extremely frank, candid, and direct in expressing his thoughts without concern for others' feelings. Despite his crusty, hot-tempered demeanor and occasional stubbornness, he possesses an underlying warmth, appreciates companionship, and develops a genuine fondness for those he likes.

_Sources: [v2 c1 P5](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0005), [v2 c1 P6](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0006), [v2 c1 P11](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0011), [v2 c1 P13](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0013), [v2 c1 P21](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0021), [v2 c3 P22](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0022), [v2 c3 P49](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0049)_

## Traits

- Eccentric and unconventional  <sub>[v2 c1 P5](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0005)</sub>
- Blunt and candid in speech  <sub>[v2 c1 P13](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0013), [v2 c3 P22](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0022)</sub>
- Short-tempered  <sub>[v2 c1 P11](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0011), [v2 c2 P23](../source/v02-c02.md#nw-v02-c02-p0023)</sub>
- Frugal and stingy  <sub>[v2 c1 P6](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0006)</sub>
- Self-conscious about his baldness  <sub>[v2 c1 P22](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0022)</sub>

## Abilities

- Skillful at making tea  <sub>[v2 c3 P34](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0034)</sub>

## History

After moving to Brierley, Mr. Pettifer established a reputation for eccentricity and stinginess. On an August afternoon, he confronted Nell Harcourt in a rage after finding her Jersey cow in his oats, resulting in a heated argument about the cow and his baldness. He later accidentally sold his own Jersey cow to a buyer when Nell mistook it for hers; upon discovering the error, he accepted Nell's apology, traded cows with her, and shared a cake and tea she brought him. Later, he reunited with his estranged wife, Emily, when she arrived at his home after reading a false rumor of his marriage in a newspaper. When his parrot, Nutmeg, was killed during a severe thunderstorm, he mourned the bird deeply. Over time, he became a kind neighbor to Nell, frequently chatting with her on his veranda and offering advice on her writing efforts.

_Sources: [v2 c1 P3](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0003), [v2 c1 P11](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0011), [v2 c1 P13](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0013), [v2 c1 P21](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0021), [v2 c2 P23](../source/v02-c02.md#nw-v02-c02-p0023), [v2 c3 P20](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0020), [v2 c3 P22](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0022), [v2 c3 P31](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0031), [v2 c3 P49](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0049), [v2 c4 P43](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0043), [v2 c25 P0](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0000), [v2 c25 P15](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0015), [v2 c25 P47](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0047), [v2 c25 P50](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0050), [v2 c25 P60](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0060)_

## Background by volume

- Originally resided in Scottsford, New Brunswick, where his sister previously managed his household.  <sub>[v2 c25 P57](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0057)</sub>
- Married Emily Scott, a former schoolteacher, at the dying request of his sister.  <sub>[v2 c25 P57](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0057)</sub>
- Separated from his wife after three years of marriage over domestic friction and her hatred of his parrot, Nutmeg.  <sub>[v2 c25 P57](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0057), [v2 c25 P58](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0058), [v2 c25 P59](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0059)</sub>
- Relocated to St. Brendan's Island and bought Robert Bell's farm in Brierley.  <sub>[v2 c1 P5](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0005), [v2 c25 P59](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0059)</sub>

## Quotes

> I’m a crabbed, lonesome, crusty old chap, but I feel young again because of something about that little girl . . . and having that sensation repeated once in a while is something I’d like, since it’s so pleasant.  <sub>[v2 c3 P49](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0049)</sub>

> On occasion, I am overly impetuous myself, miss . . . much too impetuous. However, I am unable to refrain from voicing my exact thoughts, and people are required to accept me as I am.  <sub>[v2 c3 P22](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0022)</sub>

> I never claimed to be. Had anyone inquired whether I was a married man, I would have answered that I was. Everyone simply assumed it.  <sub>[v2 c25 P51](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0051)</sub>


## Relationships

### Emily Pettifer

- Spouse of — His wife, a former schoolteacher from Scottsford with whom he separated before eventually reuniting.  <sub>[v2 c25 P0](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0000), [v2 c25 P57](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0057), [v2 c25 P58](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0058), [v2 c25 P60](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0060)</sub>

### John Henry Carter

- Commands — His hired boy who works on his farm.  <sub>[v2 c1 P6](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0006)</sub>

### Agatha Sowerby

- Rival of — A Brierley neighbor whom he strongly dislikes due to her meddling nature.  <sub>[v2 c1 P8](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0008), [v2 c9 P0](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0000), [v2 c25 P0](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0000)</sub>

### Nell Harcourt

- Friend of — His neighbor who initially argued with him over a trespass incident, but later became a close friend and tea companion.  <sub>[v2 c1 P13](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0013), [v2 c3 P22](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0022), [v2 c3 P31](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0031), [v2 c3 P46](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0046), [v2 c3 P49](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0049)</sub>
